verdict.rationale: The REST API explicitly claims bulk-operation support only for editor documents and document boards. Elsewhere, cursor-based pagination and filtered list/search let scripts or agents iterate over large result sets, and the MCP server can create and update many entity types, but none of that is documented as batch processing. Bulk work across features, feedback and initiatives therefore appears to need per-item calls orchestrated by the user's script or agent. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch endpoints for features, feedback and other core entities; bulk actions via the MCP server; hands-on or independent corroboration.
